schema.description: A unique identifier for the stop that is also displayed on a sign at the stop location and may be used to access schedule information.
The name of the stop, typically containing the direction of travel, the street the stop is located on, and a nearby cross-street.
Indicates whether the stop is in use (ACTIVE) or not (INACTIVE).

scope.label: Active transit stops in or near the community
scope.caveat: Nearby means inside the community or approximately 400 metres beyond its boundary. Distances are straight-line approximations, not walking distances from a home. Stop locations do not establish service frequency or current departures.
scope.activeStatusNote: ACTIVE is the stop inventory status. Temporary closures, detours, timetables and routes require Calgary Transit service information.
scope.countNote: Counts refer to individual published stops, including separate stops for different directions. They are not counts of distinct routes or stations.
scope.geographyMethod: Original unsimplified City community polygons; local equirectangular approximation x=(longitude+114.05)*111320*cos(51.05 degrees), y=(latitude-51.05)*111320. Point-to-polygon distance cutoff 400 metres; boundary points count as inside.
scope.candidateSelection: All 740 ACTIVE records in the documented bounding box were retrieved, below the 5000-record limit. Final filtering uses geometry, not the bounding box alone.
